title: Pilot verifiable pre-GitHub role invocation without bypassing delivery approvals
business_goal: Turn existing eight-agent orchestration instructions into a real bounded read-only invocation path with explicit evidence and failure visibility.
current_behavior: AGENTS.md describes mandatory separate agents, but no linked, universally enforced executable role launcher is available for all tasks.
expected_behavior: An opt-in local launcher starts distinct constrained review processes, binds a committed work item, stops on failures, and never asserts release approval.
dependencies: Codex CLI installed on operator machine for a live role run
acceptance_criteria: Eight distinct role process requests are made in lifecycle order
Invalid or missing role evidence fails closed
A blocking reviewer halts downstream roles
Uncommitted or modified task records are rejected
No QA/UAT/release or human-approval completion is manufactured
architecture_impact: Offline optional adapter; does not modify core.delivery, trading runtime, or release authority.
uat_criteria: Operator can run read-only role review on a committed task and receives an unverified review ledger
release_gates: CI and release review required before merge
rollback_plan: Revert the pilot branch; production/runtime interfaces are unchanged.
